QF.id: VB Concept and Role of Mutual Fund_2

question.text: A mutual fund in India is structured as which of the following?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, every mutual fund in India is constituted as a trust governed by the Indian Trusts Act, 1882. Investors are the beneficiaries/unit-holders of the trust, and trustees are responsible for protecting investor interests. The Trap: A mutual fund is not a company, partnership firm, or sole proprietorship. The trust structure is mandated by the regulatory framework. Note: The trustee role exists specifically to safeguard the unit-holders as beneficiaries of the trust.
